(3) One set of names, from the rail to the bar to the address bar - I never have to translate. **Fifth visit: 5 / 5 / 5 / 4 / 5 / 4 — `simple` and `infinite potential` each moved up one, and the six-step use test passed end to end.**

**My exit condition, named before I walked:** every label delivers within one screen · I can get the page I came for with dropdowns only — pick it, send it, open it cold, save it, nest it · one set of names from the rail to the address bar · nothing broken at 1280 or 3440 · and the bounded version of *infinite potential*: **a page that did not exist when this realm was written can be pointed at, nested and configured like the twelve that ship with it.** Four of the five are true. The fifth is half true, so the list is not empty.

![A page I made an hour ago, running inside a preset, cold, from a url](shots/nested-made-page-1280.png)

**The six-step use test, all six worked.** I wanted a recipe wall — dark page, wall of cards, toolbar on top, big type, no children strip; not one of the twelve. Seven dropdowns took. The address became `?navigation=none&arrangement=bar-top&content-colour=plain&page-colour=dark&type-size=display` — **the reader's own words**. Opened cold in a fresh browser: identical classes, identical seven values, identical 922 × 380 canvas. Typed *Recipe wall*, pressed **Make this a page**, and `made/recipe-wall/page.json` appeared. **All nine of my fourth-visit items are fixed**, and I re-measured each: the drawer's code box is **291px holding 352 at the top of the drawer** (was a 22px strip), Make's rows put a page's name **7px** from its word chips (was 2,300), Build's step 7 prints all seven words, the bar's headings are the rail's six blocks, Cross is two dropdowns over 42 live cells, Navigation has a stage, and the bar is left-aligned at both widths.
